claims.explanation: Deforolimus is an allosteric mTORC1 inhibitor (rapalog), so selectivity is expected to track tumors whose growth and survival depend on mTORC1-driven translation and on upstream PI3K/AKT pathway activation. Thus, activating lesions of the PI3K/AKT/mTOR axis (PIK3CA mutation/amplification, PTEN loss, AKT overexpression, MTOR pathway activation) should sensitize, while lesions that bypass mTORC1 or activate compensatory survival pathways (e.g., KRAS/BRAF-driven MAPK signaling, high anti-apoptotic BCL2/BCL2L1) should be protective.
